questions.stem: A 34y G2 presents to the emergency with painful vaginal bleeding since a few hours. She is 32 weeks pregnant. Her last visit was at 28 weeks when her BP was 130/90 mmHg and the last ultrasound was normal; after which she did not visit. On examination, she is pale, the uterus is tense and tender, corresponding to 34 weeks. FHR is 160 bpm. What is the next best step?
